Translation_to_English: Samuel Joseph Labouri. [She] had it sent from the place ... to Rabat for the 2 bales ... Khalef, and with this note he prefers to send more, and I write thus to ship the 2 bales. Customs is requesting one bale from the lot of 24 bales. As for the invoice and offices, it must be marked indeed; there are shortfalls ... [illegible text]. ... Rabat ... I can ... the invoice ... [very difficult to read].
